name: Calendar
description: Your Google Calendar in Orca's sidebar: today's agenda and the next days, the next meeting counting down in the status bar, a join button for Meet, Zoom, Teams and Slack huddles, and a reminder before each meeting. Works with your Mac's calendars with no setup. Not affiliated with Google or Apple.

cover.alt: Calendar in Orca's sidebar: the agenda with a call starting in 4 minutes and a Join button, and the same countdown in Orca's status bar. Sample data.

settings.title: Calendar source
settings.description: Where Calendar reads your meetings. Auto uses Google Calendar once you connect it in the panel, and your Mac's calendars until then.

settings.title: Days to show
settings.description: Today and the days after it.

settings.title: Remind me before meetings
settings.description: A desktop notification before each meeting you haven't declined.

settings.title: Minutes before
settings.description: How long before a meeting the reminder shows. 0 shows it as the meeting starts.

settings.title: Show declined events
settings.description: Declined events stay in the agenda, struck through. They never count for the status bar or reminders.

settings.title: Answer invitations
settings.description: Show Yes, Maybe and No on Google Calendar invitations in the panel. Google then asks you to allow Calendar to change your events; turning this off keeps the login read-only. Takes effect when you connect Google again.

settings.title: Tick off tasks
settings.description: Show a checkbox on Google Tasks in the agenda that marks them done in Google. Google then asks you to allow Calendar to change your tasks; turning this off keeps Tasks read-only. Takes effect when you connect Google again.

settings.title: Google OAuth client ID
settings.description: From the Desktop app OAuth client you created in Google Cloud. The panel's Connect screen fills it in.

settings.title: Login port
settings.description: Port on 127.0.0.1 where Google sends you back after the login. Change it only if 43119 is taken.
